blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Congratulations! You completed the Confidence level for supply chain. This is your first supply chain day, and it is complete.

Today we review the main structures. You learned to be, Present Simple, there is and there are, have and has, and going to. These are the base of simple English.

English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. We start slow. You learn 5 new words today and you practise the review. You can do it!

items.q: What level did the student complete?
items.why: "You completed the Confidence level for supply chain."

items.q: Which structures do they review today?
options: to be, Present Simple, there is/are, have/has, going to
items.why: O texto lista todas essas estruturas como a revisão do dia.

items.q: How many new words does the student learn today?
items.why: "You learn 5 new words today."

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests that the tone is…
items.why: Inferência: a frase e "You can do it!" mostram um tom positivo, que anima o aluno.

items.q: The text says "We start slow." This suggests that…
options: the lesson is too hard for the student
the student can learn step by step, without stress
the student must finish very fast
there is no time to practise
items.why: Inferência: começar devagar significa aprender com calma, passo a passo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça a aluna falando com a professora. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, teacher. Today I want to tell you about my level. I completed the Confidence level for supply chain. I am very happy, and I am a little proud too.

First, I learned the verb to be. I can say "I am at work" and "The boxes are ready." I also learned Present Simple. I say "We ship on Monday" and "The truck leaves at nine." These are my daily words at the warehouse.

I learned there is and there are. I can say "There is one box here" and "There are ten pallets in the warehouse." I learned have and has too. "I have a plan" and "The company has a big warehouse."

And I learned going to for my plans. "I am going to check the order today" and "We are going to send the shipment tomorrow." I use going to for the future.

My confidence is growing every week. I practise every day, with small steps. I am not perfect, but I am better than before. Now I am ready for the next level. Thank you, teacher!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How does the student feel about her level?
items.why: "I completed the Confidence level… I am very happy."

items.q: Which example uses "there are"?
options: There are ten pallets in the warehouse
items.why: "There are ten pallets in the warehouse" usa there are (plural).

items.q: What is she going to do tomorrow?
items.why: "We are going to send the shipment tomorrow."

items.q: "My confidence is growing" suggests that the student…
options: feels more sure of her English now
items.why: Inferência: confiança crescendo = ela se sente mais segura com o inglês.

items.q: Why does the student say she practises "with small steps"?
options: Because she learns a little every day, calmly
items.why: Inferência: pequenos passos = aprender aos poucos, todo dia, sem pressa.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I am happy to complete the level." To complete means to…
items.why: To complete = completar, terminar algo.

items.q: "Let's review the lesson before the test." To review means to…
options: look at it again to remember
items.why: To review = revisar, olhar de novo para lembrar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ my English every day at work."
items.why: To practise = praticar; combina com "every day".

items.q: Confidence means…
options: the feeling of being sure of yourself
items.why: Confidence = confiança, sentir-se seguro.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I make good ___ in English. I am better now."
items.why: Progress = progresso; melhorar aos poucos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Take it step by step and you will learn." This means…
options: one part at a time, slowly
items.why: Step by step = passo a passo, aos poucos.

items.q: "Great job! Keep it up!" This means…
items.why: Keep it up = continue assim, mantenha o bom trabalho.

items.q: "We are ready for the next level." This means we are…
items.why: Ready for = pronto/preparado para algo.

items.q: "The manager said well done to the team." This means…
items.why: Well done = muito bem, bom trabalho.

items.q: "Don't worry, you can do it!" This is used to…
items.why: You can do it = você consegue, uma frase de incentivo.
